name: LayerNormGradBeta
note: adv_api/normalization/layernormgradbeta.h. Second LayerNorm-backward stage: reduce over (B,S). pd_gamma[h]=sum_bs(dy*resForGamma), pd_beta[h]=sum_bs(dy). 3510 impl reads tiling.{bsLength,hLength} and requires hLength*sizeof(T)%32==0. dy=2, resForGamma=3, BS=4 -> pdGamma=4*6=24, pdBeta=4*2=8.
